note: The standard deduction reduces gross income to taxable income — the figure every bracket and capital-gains threshold in this repository is measured against. Published here as the reference figure used across CryptoTaxAI's 2026 guides. The CryptoTaxAI calculators do not apply a deduction for you: they stack your gain on top of the 'other income' figure you enter, so enter taxable income (after your deduction) for the closest estimate. Additional amounts for age 65+ or blindness are not included in this table.
source: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32, Section 4.14 (standard deduction amounts under IRC § 63(c)(2))
